_meta.description: Highways, emergency contacts, and travel corridors for a small subset of districts, seeded only where a specific fact was explicitly verifiable - not a complete or invented dataset for all 77 districts.
_meta.source: Department of Roads national highway references (route descriptions only, no live dataset URL held by this project); MoHA/District Administration Office publications where cited per-entry; Better Nepal Phase 19 specification (explicit facts supplied in-spec).
_meta.notes: highways: only H02 (Tribhuvan), H04 (Prithvi) and H13 (Karnali) are seeded, and only for districts a highway's own route description names or unambiguously terminates at - not a claim of full highway coverage. emergency_contacts: exactly one verified entry (Rasuwa DEOC), the one figure this project holds a citable source for; every other district is intentionally left with no row, which the API renders as 'unknown'/unavailable rather than a placeholder number. corridors: reuses the project's existing rivers/roads reference corridor names verbatim, associated to the districts each corridor's own description names.
